stories.s: President Zelensky said a Russia warship was sunk, with a Russian cargo ship also hit.

stories.t: German police respond to multiple school bomb threats
stories.s: Police in Germany are responding to bomb threats against a series of schools, but say that at present they don't believe them to be credible. Danish authorities are reporting a similar series of apparent hoaxes.

stories.t: Trump administration deported US citizen to Mexico, DoJ admits in court
stories.s: Brian Morales García of Texas seeks damages after he was wrongly identified as undocumented in case White House wants dropped The Trump administration recently admitted in federal court that it deported a US citizen to Mexico after…

stories.t: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya
stories.s: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault.

stories.t: Who is taking part in France's recent street protests?
stories.s: President Macron has blamed the unrest on the radical left, but who are the protesters and what are they fighting for?
